purpose: Teach: 浮遊/社会民主党/脱走/懲罰/移送/送還/駆逐/政務

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、空気中の浮遊菌を医療チームで定期的に測定しております
lines.en: Ren, we measure airborne bacterial levels regularly as part of the medical team's protocol.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Measured cadence. Direct eye contact level. No rush—this is routine information being shared with care.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、社会民主党の医療政策を医療チームで参照します
lines.en: Yes, we reference the medical policy frameworks when making those assessments as a team.
lines.style: Steady continuation. Slight pause before 'frameworks'—choosing words carefully. Reassuring without being patronizing. Quiet authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 精神科患者の脱走防止策を、貴院、なさってるそうですね、先生
lines.en: I've heard your hospital has measures in place to prevent psychiatric patients from leaving without authorization, Doctor.
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely curious. Soft question mark at the end—not challenging, seeking understanding. Deferential but engaged.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療事故の懲罰委員会を医療チームで運営します
lines.en: Yes, we have an oversight committee that reviews medical incidents—part of how we maintain accountability.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. No defensiveness. Speaking to the question directly. The tone of someone used to transparency.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 重症者の移送を、貴院、ご担当されたそうですね、先生
lines.en: I understand your hospital handled the transfer of critical patients during that period.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Careful, respectful framing. Not probing—observing. Soft, reflective pace.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、外国人患者の本国送還を医療チームで調整します
lines.en: Yes, we coordinate repatriation for foreign patients who need to return home—that's handled by the team.
lines.style: Even tone, professional. Matter-of-fact explanation. No emotional weight added. Clear and honest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感染症駆逐の取り組みを、貴院、なさってるそうですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has been involved in infection control initiatives, I understand.
lines.style: Gentle, curious without pressing. Slight rise at the end—open question. Respectful distance. Thoughtful pacing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療政務に関する意見書を医療チームで提出します
lines.en: Yes, we submit policy recommendations to the appropriate channels—part of our commitment to the broader medical community.
lines.style: Final statement, measured and complete. Slight settling of tone toward the close. Professional but warm. The exhale of finishing a difficult conversation with integrity.
